verdict.rationale: Rootly's Workflows engine is explicitly documented as its automation engine, running structured actions automatically based on trigger events, run conditions, and actions, with 152 distinct workflow action types across Slack, Jira, on-call, AI, and incident operations. This directly satisfies rule-based automatic triggering on events, reinforced by alert routing rules and escalation policies that also apply condition-based automated behavior. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of workflow rule configuration in practice and more detail on conditional logic complexity beyond docs summaries.
